title: Venezuelan Cheese Quesadilla
description: A delicious Venezuelan-inspired quesadilla filled with melted cheese and served with a side of flatbread. This recipe is perfect for a quick and easy snack or light meal.
instructions: Preheat a large skillet or griddle over medium heat.
Place 2-3 slices of flatbread in the skillet.
Sprinkle shredded cheese over half of the flatbread.
Fold the flatbread in half to enclose the cheese.
Cook for 2-3 minutes or until the flatbread is crispy and the cheese is melted.
Flip the quesadilla and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Repeat with remaining flatbread and cheese.
Serve hot with a side of flatbread, if desired.
Optional: Add a drizzle of kissed for extra flavor.
